description: Source code for firmware transfer management in a TR-069 device, including subscription handling, firmware upgrade initiation, and notification processing.

methods.name: firmwareimage_notification
methods.description: Handles firmware image status change notifications, updates transfer status, and logs info.

methods.name: firmwareimage_add_sub
methods.description: Subscribes to firmware image change notifications.

methods.name: firmwareimage_del_sub
methods.description: Unsubscribes from firmware image change notifications.

methods.name: upgrade_firmware
methods.description: Initiates firmware download with specified URL, username, and password.

methods.name: transfers_firmware_do_firmwareupgrade
methods.description: Starts the firmware upgrade process, managing transfer state and parameters.

methods.name: transfers_firmware_init
methods.description: Initializes firmware transfer module and subscribes to notifications.

methods.name: transfers_firmware_clean
methods.description: Cleans up firmware transfer module and unsubscribes from notifications.

methods.name: transfers_firmware_transfer_done
methods.description: Marks the firmware transfer as completed or failed.
